summary: AudioCodes Ltd. filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report) disclosing that its board adopted and approved a Rule 10b5-1 stock trading plan to repurchase ordinary shares during periods when insider-trading laws or self-imposed blackout windows would otherwise bar buybacks. Repurchases are subject to Rule 10b-18 price, volume and timing constraints, with an independent broker granted authority under pricing parameters set in the plan. No share count, dollar authorization, price range or expiry was disclosed, and no advisor recommendation beyond board approval was named. Watch execution pace and any future authorization size as signals of capital-return intent.
